title: Social Insurance as a Tool for Talent Allocation Evidence from China's Long-Term Care Pilots
affiliations: Peking University - Guanghua School of Management

detail.title: Social Insurance as a Tool for Talent Allocation Evidence from China's Long-Term Care Pilots
detail.abstract: High-skill professions with significant positive externalities, such as nursing, often face talent shortages because their private returns are fundamentally misaligned with their social value. Can a large-scale social insurance program correct this market failure? This paper investigates whether China's landmark Long-Term Care Insurance (LTCI) pilots successfully steered high-ability students into the nursing profession. Using a comprehensive dataset of university admission scores from 2016-2022 and a generalized triple-difference (DDD) design, we find the LTCI pilots raised admission scores for nursing majors by a robust 12.9 points (0.21 SD). We show this effect is driven by two powerful channels: a reshaping of economic returns, consistent with a "superstar effect" that increased wage dispersion without affecting the median wage, and an enhancement of the profession's social prestige, driven by a strong signal of state endorsement that increased public attention. Finally, a back-of-the-envelope welfare calculation demonstrates that while this talent reallocation incurs a net cost in private returns, the required positive externalities to justify the policy as a productive social investment are plausibly modest, quantifying the economic rationale for the state's intervention.

AI.tldr: 中国长期护理保险试点通过提高护理专业录取分数12.9分，成功引导高能力学生进入护理行业，主要通过经济回报重塑和社会声望提升两个渠道实现。
AI.research_question: 中国长期护理保险试点是否成功引导高能力学生进入护理专业？
AI.motivation: 护理等高技能职业具有显著正外部性，但由于私人回报与社会价值错配而面临人才短缺，需要研究大规模社会保险计划能否纠正这种市场失灵。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场失灵理论、人力资本投资理论、信号理论（国家背书信号）
AI.method: 使用2016-2022年大学录取分数综合数据集，采用广义三重差分设计（DDD）
AI.findings: LTCI试点使护理专业录取分数提高12.9分（0.21个标准差），通过经济回报重塑（超级明星效应）和社会声望提升（国家背书信号）两个渠道实现
AI.theory_contributions: 量化了国家干预的经济合理性，证明了社会保险计划在纠正人才市场失灵方面的有效性
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实施类似社会保险计划的实证依据，展示了通过国家背书提升职业社会声望的有效途径

title: Modular Agent-Based Architecture MAA ERP: A Composable, AI-Driven Architecture for Next Generation Enterprise Systems<

detail.title: Modular Agent-Based Architecture MAA ERP: A Composable, AI-Driven Architecture for Next Generation Enterprise Systems<

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest related to the publication of this white paper. This work was conducted independently and is not affiliated with or funded by any commercial entity or organization.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, animal subjects, or sensitive personal data, and therefore did not require ethics approval under applicable institutional or national guidelines.
declarations.funderStatement: This white paper was developed without external funding. The author received no financial support from any institution, organization, or sponsor for the research, authorship, or publication of this work.

detail.abstract:
This white paper introduces a groundbreaking approach to ERP modernization through the design and deployment of modular, AI-enabled functional agents. It addresses long-standing challenges in traditional ERP systems — including vendor lock-in, limited extensibility, monolithic architectures, and integration hurdles — by proposing a decentralized, prompt-driven framework.

Each business functionality (e.g., Employee Management, Payroll Processing, Leave Request Handling) is encapsulated as a self-contained AI Agent with its own storage, rules, workflows, and service interface. All communication between agents — whether internal, cross-departmental, or cross-company — occurs through natural language prompts, eliminating the need for hardcoded APIs and enabling seamless interoperability across technologies and organizations.

The architecture strongly emphasizes:

  • Modular business functionality (e.g., Employee Leave Agent, Payroll Process Agent)

  • Human-like interactions with agents through natural language prompts

  • Cryptographic trust and data integrity

  • Vendor participation without dependency

  • Caching, messaging, and rule enforcement are handled by specialized agents

  • Declarative logic representation (no runtime code generation by AI)

This model supports not only enterprise use but also government, B2B, and individual agent collaboration — paving the way for an open marketplace of AI ERP agents.

The paper is intended for academic researchers, ERP vendors, open-source contributors, and funding bodies exploring next-generation enterprise software systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于模块化AI功能代理的ERP现代化方法，通过去中心化、提示驱动的框架解决传统ERP系统的供应商锁定、扩展性差、单体架构和集成难题。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个去中心化的、基于AI代理的ERP系统架构，以解决传统ERP系统的固有问题并实现跨组织无缝协作？
AI.motivation: 传统ERP系统存在供应商锁定、有限扩展性、单体架构和集成困难等长期挑战，需要创新的现代化解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于模块化架构理论、AI代理理论、去中心化系统设计和自然语言处理技术，构建提示驱动的功能代理框架。
AI.method: 采用模块化设计方法，将每个业务功能封装为独立的AI代理，配备自有存储、规则和工作流，通过自然语言提示进行通信。
AI.findings: 提出的架构能够实现企业、政府、B2B和个体代理之间的无缝协作，支持加密信任和数据完整性，无需硬编码API。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于AI代理的ERP现代化理论框架，为下一代企业软件系统提供了新的设计范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为ERP供应商、开源贡献者和企业提供了可实施的现代化方案，支持创建开放的AI ERP代理市场。
